entities.summary: Ebony Leea Morrison is an American-born Liberian track and field athlete, specializing in the 100 meters hurdles. At the Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympics, she ran a time of 12.74 in the women's 100m hurdles advancing to the semi finals. She also competed at the Paris 2024 Summer Olympics.
